name: Consistent Tetrahedral Subdivision
definition: A method to subdivide nonconvex problem cells (like hexahedra with nonplanar quadrilateral faces) into tetrahedra with consistent diagonals on shared faces, avoiding gaps or overlaps.
summary: Consistent Tetrahedral Subdivision decomposes non-convex cells into tetrahedra using diagonals determined by a static linear vertex order, ensuring consistent face splitting without explicit mesh connectivity.
